name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 29 – Am 22
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 29b. Condemns in the strongest terms the instrumentalisation of rule-of-law conditionality for politically motivated ideological assaults on Member States; emphasises that in these assaults, the Commission has demonstrably utilised and financed NGOs and left-leaning media outlets with EU funds; consequently, demands an immediate cessation of these attacks against national sovereignty, which are perpetrated through the misuse of rule-of-law conditionality;
